hero.eyebrow: Built for the next chapter of home

why.eyebrow: WHAT YOU WON'T HAVE TO DO
why.body: You don't pull permits, manage contractors, or chase paperwork. Groundwork runs the entire process behind the scenes. You just watch it happen, and we hand you the keys.

financing.lead: If your credit is in good shape, your home may already hold part of the answer. Groundwork helps route that equity into a clear plan for your ADU.
financing.cta: See what you may qualify for
financing.step1Body: A refinance can replace your current mortgage and create room for the ADU build in one focused financing path.
financing.step2Body: A cash-out option may let you use part of the value you've built in your home to fund the project.
financing.step3Body: Once approved, Groundwork coordinates the next steps so financing, permitting, and construction move together.
financing.note: Financing options depend on lender approval, property details, income, and credit profile. Terms vary.

edu.whatBody: An Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is an independent living space located on the same lot as your main home. It can be built from scratch or by converting existing areas such as garages or basements.
edu.challenge2: Buying a second home is out of reach for most people
edu.solution2: Housing for aging parents, adult children, or guests
edu.solution4: Easier living solutions for seniors in two-story homes

process.lead: From first conversation to keys in hand. A clear path with Groundwork and our affiliates.
process.step4Body: From design to completion in 3–5 months

numbers.title: Numbers don’t lie
numbers.item1: Over 20,000 ADUs built each year in California
numbers.item2: 1 in 3 households has the space for an ADU
numbers.item4: ADU applications have grown by more than 1,000% since state law changes

risks.title: The risk of doing it alone
risks.lead: Hiring unlicensed or inexperienced contractors can cost you more than you think:

affAgreement.w9Cert1: The number shown on this form is my correct taxpayer identification number (or I am waiting for a number to be issued to me);
affAgreement.w9Cert2: I am not subject to backup withholding because (a) I am exempt, or (b) I have not been notified by the IRS that I am subject to backup withholding, or (c) the IRS has notified me that I am no longer subject to backup withholding;
affAgreement.w9Cert3: I am a U.S. citizen or other U.S. person; and
affAgreement.w9Cert4: The FATCA code(s) entered on this form (if any) indicating that I am exempt from FATCA reporting is correct.
affAgreement.w9CertBackup: If the IRS has told you that you are currently subject to backup withholding, don't submit here. Contact Groundwork so we can handle it.
affAgreement.w9Certify: I certify the statements above under penalties of perjury and agree to sign this W-9 electronically.
